title: Samsung Galaxy S20+ the best premium smartphone with 8K video recording support
description: Samsung launched the S20 series handsets in India and here is the Samsung Galaxy S20+ unboxing and review. S20+ is unique, packed with premium features, can shoot 8K videos, 30x zoom, has 120Hhz Dynamic AMOLED display and more.  Samsung Galaxy S20 series price   Samsung Galaxy S20 - Rs. 66,999 Samsung Galaxy S20+ - Rs. 73,999 Samsung Galaxy S20 Ultra - Rs. 92,999  You can buy here - https://amzn.to/2PjA2YF  Samsung Galaxy S20+ Specs   6.7" Dynamic AMOLED, WQHD+ with 120Hz refresh rate This one comes with best camera ever on a smartphone. Mind boggling specs making it the ultimate flagship.   No doubt it is a Pro grade camera do check the samples specially the low light shots, impressive even in wide angle mode.  This is first handset to feature 8K video recording. Plus the 30x Hybrid + super resolution zoom and the single take feature for those who share their content a lot it is a quick option to make shareable content from different, with auto effects that are applied.   This is samsung's first smartphone to feature a 120Hz display (Galaxy S20+). There is 4500 mAh battery and 25W fast charger is included in the box. Other features are 8GB RAM, 128GB ROM, Exynos 990 octa core processor and New Quick share: Share photos and videos easily across ecosystem and with upto 5 neighboring devices. asr.full_text: Samsung has launched their Galaxy S20 smartphones in India And now I have the S20 Plus and in this video I am going to unbox from the S20 But before that I am going to tell you its features And yes, the S20 plus is the best premium smartphone on S20 because it comes with very advanced features Let's start with the camera This handset can shoot 8K video Yes friends 8k video Now many people will ask how it is useful Because many people don't have an 8K display If you record 1080p videos and watch it on the 1080P screen it would look good most people don't have an 8K display But, here we have included in our video in our phone And that is good If you make the video shooting in 4K resolution and you put that on your phone then the sharpness and the details will provide better result Similarly, if you are shooting video in 8K resolution and you put that on a 1080 monitor then the quality of video is much better than 4k that would not be of the same level. But it had good features. This was one of the advantages of high resolution video recording. Also you can record videos in post-production mode, which is quite nice as this is the first smartphone to be launched in India, which can do 8K recording without any problem. Although it is a bit expensive but it's still good to hold, thanks to that, it's So this is the first smartphone that is launched in India which can do 8K recording in terms of pricing, it is very good because if you go to 8K professional camera so its costing is very high the other unique thing about this smartphone camera is it supports camera's 30x zoom there is hybrid zoom and super resolution zoom features both of them have 30x screen zoom The Galaxy S20 Plus has a 64MP primary camera With 1.08um large pixel I have had some shots with the handset And I'm really impressed with that camera quality Especially for the low light shots I have used with night mode its a great shot and If you like this shot shooting in wide angle mode this is awesome I was impressed by its camera quality Guys its camera has a single take option In fact many people post their videos on social media especially on TikTok So in this single take the camera shoot video of 10 seconds or may shoot some photos along with that it makes mix-up collage Take a look at the sample This box is shot in in on single take mode This is also quite impressive This is the Samsung Gs iiS20Plus and this is its Box Pack let's unbox the box So guys lets continue Hello Guys i am Gogi. This is the Samsung Galaxy S20 plus in this box, its with 8 GB Ram 128GB of internal storage space These are the packaging of S20 and S20 mini The box comes with a 128 GB RAM internal storage space Take this bag SIM tray ejector pin Quick Start Guide, Regional Log Guide And warranty card Silicon case which will provide handset a better protection , if you want then you can use this one as it is. In fact, when people start opening this handset from box, they attach it. And these are Samsung Galaxy S20 Plus, I have that colour variant mixed in here which is Cosmic Grey. It seems to very an amazing and premium type! The box also has USB Type C to USB Type C Data Cable. AKG Premium earphones are also included inside the box. There is also a 25W fast charger included inside the box. The S20 Plus with a great build and finishing. And the glass back is also here. The premium type cellphones give you a feeling that you're on the same page. built up well and for your reference you can find other premium phone in this series. After you take them out of the box you get a special kind of satisfaction which you cannot get in any other premium phones to start with. The quality of this phone is really on point, specially these lock-off Wall-Papers are outstanding, see this is really amazing here the default wall paper I really like the theme the frame of this hand set is made up of metal like this power buttons and volume rocker on right side secondary microphone on the top speaker out vent is provided primrary microphone is there Here is a speaker out vent in the bottom The bottom is a USB Type C port and a Primary Microphone The front camera is inside the display When you twist the finger, you cannot feel it I have ejected the sim tray with it you can see this comes with the hybrid slot Usually Samsung Galaxy S smartphones have a slightly curved screen But they have got the curved screen but not this curved In fact I really liked this curved screen Now I will tell you about this anset's specifications The screen does have some curves to them, let me talk about how they come for me. This is a 6.7 inch screen with Corning Gorilla Glass 6 protection. It comes with 120 Hz refresh rate, HDR10 and Always on Display support as well. Maximum screen resolution is WQHD+, 8GB RAM, 128GB storage running is Samsung One UI 2, android 10 base There is quad cameras on the Rear dual pixel PDAF OIS camera of 12 MP Telephoto camera of 64 MP ultra-wide camera of 12 MP and 3D ToF camera and 0.3MP 3D ToF camera Front camera is of 10MP dual pixel PDAF in terms of processor it has Samsung xenos 990 octa core processor Antutu benchmark score is higher than 5 lakh it means that PUBG game is expected to run smoothly It has a 4500 mAh battery, which is quite fast Also inside the box, it has a 25 Watt fast charger So now we move to the prices of Samsung Galaxy S20 series smartphones Samsung Galaxy S20 has 3 variants available The price for which is 66999 Rs The variant I just told you Samsung Galaxy S20 plus The price starts from 73999 Rs There is another variant Samsung Galaxy S20 Ultra and it comes with 108 Megapixel primary camera. Infact it is an awesome premium level smartphone and it has a price of 92999 rupees. It costs just 12,999 INR Ok guys I will review Galaxy S20 Plus soon but that was my review for today please consider commenting your views Do like share and keep watching
